Subject: Invoicing cadence + pro-rata examples

Miguel / Priya —

Quick note on cadence: Redwood will issue monthly invoices tied to committed tranche amounts. For mid-month ramps we apply a pro-rata formula based on calendar days remaining in the invoice period and actual usage above the committed allocation. 

Example (from the attached workbook, ProRataCalc tab):
- If committed monthly amount = $120k and Atlas ramps on the 11th of a 30-day month, pro-rata for the remainder = (20/30) * committed rate for the incremental allocation, then true-up at month end.

We will include the PO number on the invoice and can provide VAT evidence as a PDF bundle alongside the first invoice. Karthik, can you confirm the specific VAT fields Atlas needs?

Thanks,
Kimberly
Head of Billing Operations | Redwood Inference

(Attachment referenced: ProRataCalc in 2027-annual-prepay-heatmap.xlsx)
